title: Movement & Sequence
description: Plan an ordered set of instructions, predict each step, and explain how a change in order can change the result.
learning_objective: Trace a short sequence from a stated starting position, write a plan that reaches a goal, and identify the first instruction that does not match the plan.

title: Making Decisions with If
description: Use a true-or-false check to decide whether an action should run, and trace what happens when the action is skipped.
learning_objective: Distinguish a condition from an action, trace both outcomes of an if statement, and place instructions inside or outside the decision deliberately.

title: Choosing Between Two Actions
description: Plan both branches of a decision, distinguish can from blocked, and explain why a possible move may still be the wrong choice.
learning_objective: Trace one selected branch of if/else, choose a safe alternative, and explain how changing the condition changes which branch runs.

title: When Actions Change the Situation
description: Track how actions change the room, identify what must happen first, and keep required conditions true while completing the plan.
learning_objective: Explain a room state before and after an action, order dependent steps, and distinguish a lasting button effect from a pressure plate that must stay held.

title: Repeating Instructions
description: Identify a repeated group of actions, choose a fixed repetition count, and separate repeated steps from steps that happen once.
learning_objective: Expand a repeat loop into its full action sequence, count actions separately from repetitions, and correct misplaced instructions or an incorrect count.

title: Repeating While Something Is True
description: Use a condition to decide whether to repeat, trace every new check, and explain what will eventually make the loop stop.
learning_objective: Trace zero, one and several while-loop repetitions; distinguish while from if and repeat; and identify a loop whose actions do not lead toward stopping.

title: Plan, Try, and Improve
description: Combine sequences, decisions, loops and changing room states into a reasoned solution, then test and improve it using evidence.
learning_objective: Break a puzzle into smaller goals, trace a combined plan, diagnose the first mismatch, and justify a correction without changing the intended result.
